correctness.rationale: The identity \(\xi_2\star g_2+x(\xi_2\star g_2)+g_1=(0\mid\xi_2(1+x))\) follows directly from the source module action and printed generators and gives a Gray-weight-\(2\) word. Exact reconstruction proves rank \(20\), excludes every weight-\(1\) vector, exhausts all \(2^{20}\) dual words, and finds exactly \(36\) of weight \(2\). The independently reconstructed rank-\(29\) original is orthogonal to this rank-\(20\) space and the hull dimension is \(1\).
